headline: Enhance ClearInstall with AI Risk Assessment
summary: Integrate public trend signals to improve ClearInstall's risk assessment capabilities, making it more accurate and user-friendly. Leverage AI-driven insights for better dependency analysis.
actions: Implement an AI model based on the 'craft-anything' signal to analyze package dependencies and predict potential risks during installation.
Utilize the 'dsh-superagent-prototype' signal to enhance the app's ability to handle complex binding.gyp files, ensuring a smoother user experience.
Incorporate real-time updates from the 'unslop' project to continuously monitor and alert users about emerging security threats in their dependencies.
